Loss report: forgejo -> argo
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the trigger is not written: the excluded name wip/** is a glob, which an equality test cannot state)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.branches (the trigger is not written: a glob has no exact regex)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: no node selector (the hosted label ubuntu-latest runs on any Linux worker; the GitHub-hosted image tools are not present)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.pull_request: EventSource and Sensor with a k8s trigger that creates a Workflow (the EventSource is github and serves GitHub webhooks only; the Sensor accepts pull requests from the same repository only, because a fork would run its code with every secret; the EventSource webhook needs Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.push: EventSource and Sensor with a k8s trigger that creates a Workflow (the EventSource is github and serves GitHub webhooks only; the Argo Events controller needs the EventBus and a ServiceAccount, and the EventSource Service needs an Ingress)
